audit_title: FinGuard Phase 4A — Isolated Integration Readiness Audit Report

card_key_logic.pandas_compatibility: Verified compatible with pandas 1.x and pandas 3.0+

calibration_and_risk_scoring_analysis.compatibility_error_mechanism: CalibratedClassifierCV validates feature_names_in_ and n_features_in_ == 23; passing 397 features triggers ValueError: X has 397 features, but CalibratedClassifierCV is expecting 23 features as input.

prototype_scoring_strategy.raw_prediction_space: Sigmoid probabilities from binary:logistic in range [0.0, 1.0]
prototype_scoring_strategy.integration_requirement: For initial integration, prototype must operate on raw sigmoid probabilities. If calibrated probabilities are required, a dedicated 397-feature calibrator must be trained on out-of-fold validation predictions.

explanation_document_gap_analysis.remediation_plan: Augment prototype_scorer.py or integration batch wrapper to split top factors into positive_drivers and negative_drivers lists and attach batch_id, customer_id, and transaction_id before document persistence.

dashboard_ui_feature_descriptions.risk_driver_resolution_gap: DashboardService.FEATURE_DESCRIPTIONS contains 13 hard-coded feature mappings. The 397-feature model introduces 374 new features (e.g. V1-V339, C1-C14, D1-D15, amount_deviation, prior_card_count, time_sin, time_cos). Without enrichment, UI will display raw column keys.
dashboard_ui_feature_descriptions.remediation_plan: Pre-populate 'description' directly in global_feature_importance items stored in the Batch document, allowing DashboardService line 245 to consume model-provided descriptions without requiring backend Java modifications.

schema_validation_requirements: Assert presence of all 392 raw IEEE-CIS base features before running feature extraction.
Assert presence of TransactionDT and TransactionID for chronological sorting and cyclical timing.
Raise explicit SchemaValidationError if input DataFrame is missing any required raw columns.

isolation_principles: Target isolated test database 'finguard_shadow' or in-memory evaluation buffers.
Zero interference with active fraud analyst dashboard or alert queue.
Zero modification to active batch ID sequences (BATCH-YYYY-NNNN).

shadow_execution_flow.step_1: Ingest transaction batch from authoritative IEEE-CIS validation stream.
shadow_execution_flow.step_2: Simultaneously score batch with production 23-feature model (active) and prototype 397-feature model (shadow).
shadow_execution_flow.step_3: Persist active results to production 'finguard' DB; write shadow results to 'finguard_shadow' or emit in-memory parity and divergence metrics.
shadow_execution_flow.step_4: Compute comparative telemetry: risk score distribution, alert volume, fraud recall at threshold, and latency profiles.

comparative_metrics_to_capture: Mean, median, and standard deviation of risk scores.
Count and percentage of HIGH (>= 75), MEDIUM (40-74), and LOW (< 40) alerts.
Confusion matrix and ROC-AUC against validation ground truth.
Divergence matrix (transactions classified differently by the two models).

test_cases.description: Verifies that behavioural_xgboost.json and feature_columns.json load without errors, booster contains 700 trees, and feature count is exactly 397.
Verifies that booster.feature_names matches feature_columns.json['behavioural'] in exact 1-to-1 sequence.
Verifies that missing values in card1-card6 are converted to 'nan' strings and do not propagate nullable NA or drop groups during groupby.
Verifies that prior_card_count starts at 0 for cold starts and prior_amount_mean evaluates strictly before current transaction.
Verifies that amount_deviation equals (amt - prior_mean) / abs(prior_mean) and handles cold starts gracefully as NaN.
Verifies that time_sin and time_cos lie strictly in [-1.0, 1.0] across all timestamps.
Verifies that probability in [0.0, 1.0] maps monotonically to risk score in [0.0, 100.0] and risk levels map to HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW correctly.
Verifies that generated SHAP factors adhere strictly to TopFactor subdocument schema (feature, value, shap_value, impact, description).
Verifies that full explanation document contains base_value, top_factors, positive_drivers, and negative_drivers.

risks.title: Raw Ingestion Schema Deficit in Local Environment
risks.impact: Running prototype against ml/data/train_transaction.csv (25 cols) will fail immediately with missing column ValueError.
risks.mitigation: Ingest directly from full IEEE-CIS dataset at C:/Users/Santhosh/Downloads/ieee-fraud-detection/train_transaction.csv or implement strict pre-flight schema validation.

risks.title: Calibrator Incompatibility
risks.impact: Existing finguard_calibrator.joblib expects 23 features. Passing 397 features triggers fatal runtime exception.
risks.mitigation: Do not invoke finguard_calibrator.joblib. Use raw sigmoid probabilities scaled to 0-100 or train a dedicated 397-feature calibrator on validation predictions.

risks.title: TreeSHAP Batch Latency
risks.impact: TreeSHAP on 700 trees x 397 features takes ~1.1 ms per transaction (~130s for 118,108 transactions). Synchronous processing will cause request timeouts.
risks.mitigation: Execute batch scoring and TreeSHAP asynchronously in background workers, or compute explanations only for transactions flagged with risk_score >= 40.0.

risks.title: Customer Profile Mapping Discrepancy
risks.impact: Production pipeline derives customer_id from card1, addr1, and email, whereas Kaggle model groups by card1-card6 composite card_key.
risks.mitigation: Maintain the customer_id derivation in data_loader.py while extracting card_key independently for behavioural velocity features.

risks.title: UI Feature Description Fallback
risks.impact: Backend DashboardService only maps 13 feature descriptions; 374 new features would render raw technical codes in the frontend.
risks.mitigation: Ensure batch scorer pre-populates human-readable descriptions in Batch.global_feature_importance and TopFactor.description.

prerequisites: Verified presence and accessibility of full IEEE-CIS dataset (590,540 rows, 394 cols).
Production model and calibrator remain locked and unmodified.
Dedicated shadow database 'finguard_shadow' or in-memory execution harness configured.
Automated test suite implemented and passing 100% prior to any data pipeline modifications.
User review and explicit sign-off on Phase 4A audit findings.

recommended_implementation_sequence.title: Automated Prototype Regression Test Suite
recommended_implementation_sequence.description: Create ml/tests/test_kaggle_prototype_integration.py validating model loading, 397 feature ordering, missing-value handling, risk-score conversion, and schema compatibility.

recommended_implementation_sequence.title: Isolated Shadow Batch Scoring Harness
recommended_implementation_sequence.description: Implement ml/kaggle_prototype/shadow_batch_scorer.py writing exclusively to 'finguard_shadow' or in-memory comparison objects without modifying production MongoDB collections.

recommended_implementation_sequence.title: Dual-Model Comparative Evaluation
recommended_implementation_sequence.description: Execute shadow run on the 118,108 validation transactions, logging comparative score distributions, alert volumes, and latency metrics.

recommended_implementation_sequence.title: Calibrator & Explanation Alignment
recommended_implementation_sequence.description: Fit an optional 397-feature isotonic calibrator on validation predictions and enrich explanation factor descriptions for Vesta and C/D features.

recommended_implementation_sequence.title: Production Migration Gate
recommended_implementation_sequence.description: Provide a complete verification report and rollback plan for formal approval before switching production batch scoring.
